After the [[Clone Wars]] and the fall of the [[Techno Union]],<ref name="Core Worlds, Colonies, Inner Rim, and Expansion Region" /> the [[Galactic Empire]] '''occupied''' the [[planet]] of [[Skako Minor]],<ref name="Doctor Aphra 15" /> which had served as the Union's headquarters.<ref name="Old Databank">{{Databank|skako-minor|Skako Minor}} {{C|version archived on September 10, 2019; content now replaced}}</ref> The Union's [[Foreman]] [[Wat Tambor]] had been [[Death|killed]] by the [[Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]] during the [[mission to Mustafar]] as well, with Vader then being [[Mission to Skako Minor (Darth Vader)|dispatched]] to Skako Minor to wipe out Tambor's remaining supporters and establish a [[Skakoan Council|pro-Imperial regime]].<ref name="Vader 28" /> The [[Skakoan]]s were left to live under the rule of the [[Imperial Military]] in rubble of their civilization.<ref name="Doctor Aphra 15" />

[[Hallio Bas]] became an Imperial collaborator with the hope his actions would one day lead to the end of the occupation, making deals with the Imperial Military that if he brought looters into their grasp they would eventually free the planet. Nonetheless, the Empire did not keep its word and remained, with Bas's final deception coming when he lured a [[Son-tuul Pride]] [[Aphra's crew|team]] into an Imperial trap. [[Doctor]] [[Chelli Lona Aphra]] used an engineered [[Tooka]] named [[Flufto]] to [[Death|kill]] Bas and<ref name="Doctor Aphra 15" /> most of the Imperial detachment<ref name="Doctor Aphra 16">[[Doctor Aphra (2016) 16|''Doctor Aphra'' (2016) 16]]</ref> he had led them towards.<ref name="Doctor Aphra 15" /> Later, Tambor's grandson [[Jul Tambor|Jul]] attempted to [[Uprising on Skako Minor|liberate]] the planet and established a [[Blockade of Skako Minor|blockade]].<ref name="Vader 28" />
